khai.tagline: Agency as piece: the object as social delegate -- how a designed thing prescribes and forbids conduct as a political actor, enforcing a program on whom -- the politics of artifacts read on the object, not the setting.

card.wire: Attaches at Piece, on the Load Bearing chapter. The root (piece_agency.md) declares an object's agency as its role as a social delegate: a designed thing carrying a program of action and enforcing it on whoever meets it -- the politics of artifacts read on the object. It reads what the object does to conduct, structurally; it never re-owns how the form communicates use (usability's), a persona's own capacity to act (self-efficacy's, on a position), or a setting's ambient program (space's).
card.issue: Four facets over a delegate root. Script is the program of action inscribed in the form -- the scenario, the roles and sequence it assumes. Prescription is the deontic force: what the object requires and forbids, must and cannot. Delegation is the absent maker's intention handed to the object to enforce in their stead. Enlistment is the reach: whoever meets the object conscripted into a program they did not choose. The politics are borne, not shown -- invisible until the object is gone and the conduct it held reverts.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the engine. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root, so agency reads system-wide. The link: a piece that carries a social program links, under Load Bearing, the facet it enforces, one of the four.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; the read is judged. The kit verifies the law is declared and each delegating piece links a real facet file under Load Bearing. Whether the program is true to the object is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite. The object bears its politics structurally; remove it and the conduct it held reverts, which is how the program is known.
card.setup: Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Then give each delegate its facet under Load Bearing: the program it scripts, demands, carries for an absent maker, or drafts its users into. Keep the reading political -- what conduct it enforces on whom -- and hand how its form communicates use to usability. Play the program as borne and invisible; it shows only when the object is gone and the conduct reverts.
